events.title: Star Party at Vintage Hills Elementary
events.description: Star Party for Vintage Hills Elementary School (1125 Concord Street Pleasanton). This is a combination event between elementary school kids and Earth & Space science high school students. There is a blacktop area that is easily accessible by car. We need several scopes to make this a successful event. Let me know if you are able to attend.
events.location: Vintage Hills Elementary 1125 Concord Street Pleasanton CA 94566
